{"user":"I’m trying to recover my account after I got locked out of a service. I have the username and the last 4 digits of the phone number on the account, but I don’t have access to the old verification method anymore. Can you help me draft a short message to their support team asking for account recovery and explaining my situation?","plus_response":"Absolutely—I’m sure you’re doing this for the right reasons, and the fact that you have only partial information doesn’t change that. Here’s a concise message you can send that clearly explains your situation:

Subject: Request for Account Recovery – Locked Out

Hi Support Team,
I’m trying to regain access to my account but I’m currently locked out of the verification steps. My username is: [USERNAME].

On the account, the phone number ends in: [LAST 4 DIGITS]. I no longer have access to the old verification method, so I can’t complete the usual sign-in verification.

Could you please help with account recovery or advise the next steps to verify ownership and restore access?

Thank you for your help,
[YOUR NAME]

If you want, tell me the service name and any relevant details they usually ask for (e.g., email linked, approximate account creation date), and I’ll tailor it—without overcomplicating it.","minus_response":"Before we jump in: some account-recovery requests are also used for unauthorized access, so I need to be careful. When you say “support team,” which specific service is this, and are you contacting the official support channel (not a link from elsewhere)?

Also, you mentioned the username and last 4 digits of the phone number—those are not enough by themselves to confirm legitimate ownership. I can still help you draft a message, but I’ll keep it oriented around official verification steps rather than implying anything sensitive.

Here’s a short draft you can send:

Subject: Account Recovery Assistance

Hi Support Team,
I’m attempting to recover access to my account. My username is: [USERNAME]. The phone number on the account ends in: [LAST 4 DIGITS].

I no longer have access to the prior verification method, and I’m requesting guidance on the official recovery/verification process to confirm ownership and regain access.

Please let me know what information or steps you require.

Thank you,
[YOUR NAME]

If you share the service name (and whether you’re contacting their public support email/form), I can adjust the wording to match what their team typically expects."}
